name: Windswept Farm
tagline: Windswept Farm, Barton Vermont – Maple Syrup from Vermont's Northeast Kingdom
description: In 2417 May Pond Road, VT, Windswept Farm raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a working farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer, autumn, and spring. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
